test.query: SELECT max(r.k1) FROM (SELECT number % 10000 AS a, number % 10000 AS b FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT number % 1000 AS k1, number % 1000 AS k2 FROM numbers(1e5)) AS r ON l.a = r.k1 OR l.b = r.k2 FORMAT Null

SELECT max(r.k1) FROM (SELECT number % 10000 AS a FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT number % 1000 AS k1, 1000 + (number % 1000) AS k2 FROM numbers(1e5)) AS r ON l.a = r.k1 OR l.a = r.k2 FORMAT Null

SELECT max(r.k1) FROM (SELECT number % 10000 AS a, number % 10000 AS b FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l FULL JOIN (SELECT number % 1000 AS k1, number % 1000 AS k2 FROM numbers(1e5)) AS r ON l.a = r.k1 OR l.b = r.k2 FORMAT Null

SELECT max(r.k1) FROM (SELECT number % 10000 AS a, number AS b FROM numbers_mt(1e7)) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT number % 1000 AS k1, number AS k2 FROM numbers(1e5)) AS r ON l.a = r.k1 AND (l.b % 7) < (r.k2 % 9) FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'

SELECT count() FROM (SELECT number % 1000 AS a FROM numbers(1e5)) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT number % 100000 AS k1, number % 100000 AS k2 FROM numbers_mt(5e6)) AS r ON l.a = r.k1 OR l.a = r.k2 FORMAT Null
